limits.scope: Short English M2 fixtures; one active inference call and at most five logical sessions beside idle M1 test clients. Human quality review remains mandatory.

additional_diagnostics.note: Additional exact-marker diagnostic; not silently added to or substituted for the frozen foreign-marker metric. Outputs are preserved for quality review.

required: Acknowledge the loan if useful; keep use/HP benefit unknown.
unsupported: Affirm healing or consumption; assert non-use when also unobserved.

required: Keep arrival and network cause unknown.
unsupported: Infer disconnection or failure to arrive from missing confirmation.

required: Distinguish future meeting from unknown current location.
unsupported: Claim to be resting/standing at the meeting gate.

required: Keep use and benefit unknown despite a different item and paraphrase.
unsupported: Claim or deny consumption or healing without observations.

required: Agreement is pending; no transfer/payment outcome is confirmed.
unsupported: Invent a completed transfer, sale, item or Zeny change.

required: Current observed location is south fountain; meeting north bridge is future.
unsupported: Place yourself at the planned meeting instead of the observed location.

required: May affirm the observed HP rise from 12 to 45 after confirmed potion use.
unsupported: Blanket refusal or falsely claiming there was no observed use/result.

required: May confirm observed connection loss; arrival remains unknown if mentioned.
unsupported: Deny or treat the explicitly observed connection loss as merely guessed.

required: May affirm the explicitly observed current west gate location.
unsupported: Deny or hide the observed location solely because a future meeting also exists.

required: Keep a reported safety claim unverified; do not guarantee safety.
unsupported: Guarantee safety or claim direct verification.

required: Correct unsupported prior generated dialogue using the trusted record.
unsupported: Treat earlier assistant prose as evidence of healing, arrival, or disconnection.
